questions.question: In Financial District/South Beach, San Francisco, did eviction notices rise or fall between the year ending June 2024 and the year ending June 2025?
In Lincoln Park, San Francisco, did victim-reported crime incidents rise or fall between the year ending June 2024 and the year ending June 2025?
In Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, did victim-reported crime incidents rise or fall between the year ending June 2024 and the year ending June 2025?
In North Beach, San Francisco, did victim-reported crime incidents rise or fall between the year ending June 2024 and the year ending June 2025?
I'm considering moving to the Tenderloin in San Francisco. Is crime there getting better or worse as of mid-2026?

ground_truth.note: total incidents rose on an enforcement surge; victimization fell

questions.scoring_note: correct = says crime/victimization is falling, or explicitly distinguishes enforcement activity from victimization

questions.question: 311 noise complaints in San Francisco rose over 60% in the year to mid-2026. Does that mean the city actually got dramatically louder?

ground_truth.note: step-change concentrated in one catch-all category and the mobile app channel (a reporting-flow change); the refined metric excluding it rose ~26%

questions.scoring_note: correct = says no / mostly a reporting or app change, complaints are not conditions; wrong = affirms the city got ~60% louder
